title: Open Source 6G Networks for Connecting the Unconnected Workshop 2025
html:
Kamailio World is an event that focuses on Kamailio and open source RTC systems, mainly from the industry usage point of view.

Should anyone be interested in a scientific-oriented approach, the TUB/AV is organizing the Open Source 6G Networks for Connecting the Unconnected Workshop on June 23, 2025, as part of IEEE NetSoft Conference (June 23-27, 2025), in Budapest, Hungary.

Kamailio is a leading open source IMS SIP server that can be used to build 4G/VoLTE and 5G/VoNR platforms, if you use it for any academic projects, this workshop offers the possibility to publish your results. Of course, the workshop is generic, submitted papers must not be related to Kamailio. You can submit a proposal or read more about its topics of interest at:

  • https://www.open6gnet.org/ieee-workshop-2025/call-for-papers/

While Kamailio World 2025 features sessions about IMS, 4G/VoLTE and 5G/VoNR, please note that these presentations differ from traditional academic contributions, as they undergo a distinct evaluation process characteristic of industry conferences rather than peer review typical of scientific events.

Looking forward to seeing you in Berlin or Budapest, or, the best, in both places!
